data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior year reserve strengthening of $4.915 million in 2019, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This adverse development is primarily attributed to natural catastrophe events from prior years, specifically Hurricanes Harvey and Irma (2017) and Hurricanes Michael and Florence (2018), which had previously impacted loss ratios for those underwriting years. The syndicate's portfolio has material natural catastrophe exposure, particularly to windstorm and earthquake perils.
raw_causal_phrases: The SPA has material natural catastrophe exposure and hence the loss ratios particularly reflect the impacts of Hurricanes Harvey and Irma to the 2017 calendar year (impacting the 2017 year of account) and Hurricanes Michael and Florence to the 2018 calendar year (impacting the 2017 and 2018 years of account).
data.data_quality_notes: Gross premium mix extracted from the Managing Agent's report business class summary, as no dedicated segmental analysis note was available. Prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle, as no explicit prior year movement note or narrative was found. Only the 2017 underwriting year had sufficient development periods to contribute to prior year development.
